checks.claim: 1928生于费城（日精度沿用通载12月7日，本轮读录仅至年）；十六岁入宾大、师从哈里斯、经其引介随古德曼学哲学、希伯来语荣誉论文扩展为硕士论文；1955获博士；1955起任教MIT至Institute Professor、2002退休、2017起亚利桑那桂冠教授。
checks.locator: Life节（born in Philadelphia in 1928 to Jewish immigrant parents; attended Penn at 16; studied philosophy with Goodman on Harris's advice; honors thesis on Modern Hebrew became MA thesis; doctorate 1955; assistant professor at MIT in 1955; retired 2002; Arizona since 2017）＋arizona（worked since 1955; Institute Professor）＋mit（现职衔）

checks.claim: 博士阶段理论构想扩展为《逻辑结构语言理论》（1950年代写成，1975年出版）；「博士论文《转换分析》」旧说维持删除。
checks.locator: Tomalin 2006 cited as tracing antecedents of 'Chomsky's magnum opus (1955/1956; published 1975)'；iep-chomsky（Logical Structure of Linguistic Theory published 1975, written in the 1950s）

checks.claim: 能力/运用之分（1965）、短语结构与转换规则、深层/表层结构属1957至1960年代中期框架、原则与参数（1981起）及其演化解释负担。
checks.locator: Competence and performance节（introduced in Chomsky 1965; tacit grasp of structural properties）＋sep-innate（P&P attributed to Chomsky 1981 as shift from Transformational Grammar）

checks.claim: 最简方案：Merge为唯一必要运算、词库与两个接口、演化动机（若语言专有的只有Merge则进化负担大减）。
checks.locator: §3.3 The Minimalist Program（Chomsky 1995 as origin of Minimalism; Merge as core operation; links to Hauser, Chomsky & Fitch 2002）

checks.claim: I-language/E-language（1986）：E兼指外延与心灵外、被批评缺乏同一性条件；I为科学对象。
checks.locator: 'I-Language' and 'E-Language'节（Chomsky 1986 introduced; deprecates E-language as fictional; 'we can define E-language in one way or another or not at all'）
